title: 2026 maritime MRV revocation and UK ETS transition QA controls

sources.title: Merchant Shipping MRV CO2 Emissions Revocation Regulations 2026
UK Emissions Trading Scheme for maritime: how to comply

facts.source_fact: The 2026 instrument revokes the existing UK maritime CO2 monitoring, reporting and verification instruments.
facts.expected_handling: Represent the legacy MRV regime as revoked only from its legal effective position.

facts.source_fact: The revocation instrument page was published on 22 January 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Keep publication date distinct from laying and operational transition dates.

facts.source_fact: The statutory instrument was laid before Parliament on 18 March 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Store laying date as legislative provenance.

facts.source_fact: The instrument proceeded with the published negative statutory-instrument status.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve legislative-procedure status rather than inferring policy effect from publication alone.

facts.source_fact: The legacy UK framework retained EU Regulation 2015/757 after EU exit.
facts.expected_handling: Keep the legacy legal instrument identity when mapping old records.

facts.source_fact: The legacy framework also retained Commission implementing and delegated regulations from 2016.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve the specific regime lineage for historical records.

facts.source_fact: The Merchant Shipping MRV and Port State Control Amendment Regulations 2017 formed part of the legacy framework.
facts.expected_handling: Version historical UK compliance evidence to the applicable instrument.

facts.source_fact: The 2018 EU Exit amendment regulations also formed part of the legacy framework.
facts.expected_handling: Keep EU-exit amendments attached to legacy records.

facts.source_fact: A June 2025 post-implementation review recommended revocation because the legacy regulations had not fulfilled their intended purpose.
facts.expected_handling: Treat the PIR conclusion as policy evidence, not as emissions data.

facts.source_fact: UK ETS maritime expansion from July 2026 replaces the existing standalone MRV system for the relevant scope.
facts.expected_handling: Route post-transition compliance to UK ETS maritime requirements.

facts.source_fact: Revocation aims to remove uncertainty, confusion and potential costs from overlapping regulatory systems.
facts.expected_handling: Avoid double-counting legacy and UK ETS reporting obligations.

facts.source_fact: The first UK ETS maritime scheme year runs from 1 July to 31 December 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Use half-year 2026 monitoring boundaries.

facts.source_fact: From 2027 UK ETS maritime scheme years run from 1 January to 31 December.
facts.expected_handling: Version scheme-year boundaries correctly.

facts.source_fact: UK ETS maritime monitoring covers CO2, methane and nitrous oxide within scheme scope.
facts.expected_handling: Do not reduce the new regime to CO2-only monitoring.

facts.source_fact: Maritime operators must submit verified annual emissions reports by 31 March following the scheme year.
facts.expected_handling: Track reporting deadline separately from surrender deadline.

facts.source_fact: The 2026 and 2027 maritime scheme years use the special double-surrender arrangement with surrender by 30 April 2028.
facts.expected_handling: Do not apply the normal next-year surrender deadline to the first two maritime years.

facts.source_fact: The surrender obligation is one allowance for each tonne CO2e in the emissions figure for surrender.
facts.expected_handling: Keep allowance accounting tied to verified emissions-for-surrender.

facts.source_fact: Monitoring must follow an approved emissions monitoring plan and supporting procedures.
facts.expected_handling: Require monitoring-plan provenance before accepting annual data.

facts.source_fact: Historical legacy-MRV records and UK ETS maritime records have different legal bases and greenhouse-gas scopes.
facts.expected_handling: Keep separate regime identifiers in the data model.

facts.source_fact: Revocation and replacement do not justify inferring that historic compliance automatically satisfies UK ETS obligations.
facts.expected_handling: Require regime-specific compliance evidence.

guard_patterns.handling: Attach legal regime, vessel activity, gas scope and scheme year.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents mixing legacy MRV with UK ETS maritime.

guard_patterns.handling: Attach publication, laying and scheme-transition dates.
Carry legal-instrument, monitoring-plan and verified-report provenance.
Do not convert maritime regulatory records into parcel-level measured emissions.
